description: Choose fixed database RAM: 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096 MiB. Free permits only 256 MiB; larger sizes require Paid. Included total disk is 500, 1024, 2048, 4096 or 8192 MiB, including PostgreSQL/WAL, plus seven-day backups. Prices are 10, 20, 40, 80 or 160 credits per active hour respectively, prorated. Sleep follows 300 idle seconds; sleeping has no active-RAM charge. No separate database CPU, network or connection charges apply. First read database_compute_get, explain the size, price, possible interruption and shared Dev/Prod scope, then obtain the user's choice before confirm=true. Smaller volumes need a separate data move. Poll the original operation; never duplicate a pending request. Legacy profile input applies only during provider transition. Supply exactly one of memory_mib and profile.
